diagram_kind: point blowup with exceptional-subscheme incidence and conditional strict-transform contact
why_warranted: A small local incidence diagram can distinguish the exceptional fiber from the strict transforms, mark the unique point q, and make explicit that the strict multiplicity inequality is conditional on q lying on Z'. The reduced intersection Y'∩E and the multiplicity-one separation case are also concrete visual checks.

objects: closed subschemes Y,Z⊂X under the stated hypotheses
maps_and_relations: Draw the blowup morphism π:X'→X and label the fiber over p by E=π^{-1}(p).
Show Y'→Y as an isomorphism and mark that Y' has exactly one point q over p.
Show the scheme-theoretic intersection Y'∩E as the single reduced point q, with m_q(Y'∩E)=1.
Branch the Y'-Z' incidence condition: if q∈Z', label m_q(Y'∩Z')<m_p(Y∩Z); if q∉Z', show no Y'-Z' contact over p.
When m_p(Y∩Z)=1, show the q∉Z' branch and hence disjointness of Y' and Z' over p.
scope_and_visual_conventions: Use the term exceptional subscheme E; do not assume E is a smooth curve, an integral curve, or isomorphic to P¹.
Do not portray the ambient scheme X as a smooth surface: only locally Noetherian is assumed.
Keep the strict multiplicity inequality conditional on q∈Z'.
The initial condition that the generic point of Y is not contained in Z is part of the hypothesis ensuring the local intersection setup; do not silently replace Z by a branch or assume Z is integral.

correctness_checks.blowup_map_and_exceptional_fiber: pass: π:X'→X is the blowup in p and E is its fiber π^{-1}(p)
correctness_checks.strict_transform_map: pass: Y'→Y is an isomorphism under the stated regularity of O_{Y,p}; exactly one point q of Y' lies over p
correctness_checks.exceptional_intersection: pass: Y'∩E is the single reduced point q and has multiplicity 1
correctness_checks.conditional_contact_claim: pass: strict inequality applies only if q∈Z'; otherwise the strict transforms do not meet over p
correctness_checks.multiplicity_one_case: pass: if m_p(Y∩Z)=1, then q∉Z' and Y',Z' are disjoint over p
correctness_checks.ambient_hypotheses: pass: diagram should not imply X is regular or E has a specified geometric shape
